messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: P1 - gpu_capacity_alert - autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes for cluster: inference-prod-usw2. Queue backlog growing >2500, error rate rising.

alex (oncall): getting alerts from our synthetic tests, 504s on /v1/chat and long tail latency. dashboards show queue depth spikes in the GPU queue.

priya (sre): looking at cluster-autoscaler logs: repeated errors `Error: iam:PassRoleDenied` and `STS AssumeRole denied` when attempting to create instances for nodegroup gpu-pool-2. CA attempted scale x18 in last 7m.

cam (infra): checking cloud audit trails now. Noticed a policy change ~35m ago on our infra-role restricting AssumeRole to requests from a specific sourceVpc. That will block autoscaler-created nodes when launched in other subnets.

ops-bot: cloud event snippet: `Event: ModifyRolePolicy policyName=restrict-source-vpc actor=infra-cli user=infra-bot change=addCondition(sourceVpc)`).

nina (prod-eng): customer impact? any customers fully failing?

leo (se): some customers hit retries; embeddings latency up ~2x for a subset of tenants in us-west-2. No full data loss but noticeable SLA degradation.

alex (oncall): mark incident customer-impacting, notify support, prepare short message for status page.

customer-svc: Posting status: "Investigating increased latency for model inference in US-WEST-2. Engineers are working on mitigation."

priya (sre): mitigation plan: 1) shift low-priority traffic off GPU models to CPU fallback; 2) create emergency manual node pool inside allowed VPC and attach instance-profile manually; 3) request infra rollback of restrictive condition.

cam (infra): I can request rollback but security needs to approve. pinging policy owner for emergency approval.

nina (prod-eng): I'll deploy a runtime traffic rule to reduce traffic to raven-13b by 40% and divert to raven-6b-quant. That should drop GPU pressure. Deploying flag now.

ops-bot: feature-flag change: `gpu_fallback=enabled` applied, routing shift estimated reduction ~38%.

priya (sre): manually provisioning nodes: I'll spin up 2x a2.large-gpu in allowed subnet and tag with `team=inference` and taint `gpupartition=manual:NoSchedule`. Need someone to add tolerations for the high-priority pods.

cam (infra): started instance launch via console with manual instance-profile attach. Instances launched: i-0f3a9b2c, i-0f3a9b3d. Attach succeeded.

ops-bot: kube events: nodes joined: `ip-10-0-23-45.usw2`, `ip-10-0-24-16.usw2`. Labels applied: `kubernetes.io/role=gpu`, taint: `gpupartition=manual:NoSchedule`.

leo (se): added toleration to inference-prod pods and forced eviction for low-priority batch jobs. Prod pods scheduled onto new nodes. Observing queue decrease.

priya (sre): CA still logs AssumeRole denied for managed pools — manual nodes are a stopgap. We need infra rollback or update offline to use allowed subnets.

cam (infra): security approved emergency rollback for the policy condition. Rolling back the sourceVpc condition now. Expected propagation ~8-12m.

ops-bot: cloud audit: role policy rolled back by policy-owner.

priya (sre): waiting for CA to succeed on next scale attempt. Restarting cluster-autoscaler to pick up any credential updates. `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/cluster-autoscaler`

ops-bot: CA logs after restart:
```
I0321 22:06:12 autoscaler.go:240] Refreshing cloud provider credentials
I0321 22:06:14 scale.go:490] attempting scale up: creating instances in managed autoscaling group gpu-pool-2
I0321 22:06:22 scale.go:562] scale up succeeded: 3 instances launched
```

priya (sre): autoscaler scale-up succeeded and new managed nodes joined. Queue levels returned to baseline within ~10m.

nina (prod-eng): updating status page: "Mitigation applied: traffic routed to fallback models and temporary GPU capacity added. Automated scaling restored; monitoring ongoing."

alex (oncall): handoff: I'll stay for 30m of overlap, then hand to priya for night shift. Priya, please confirm autoscaler stability checks every 15m.

priya (sre): taking handoff. I'll run a 2hr watch: check CA logs, queue depth, and cloud quota/errors.

leo (se): post-incident action: recommend adding infra-cli preflight check to detect policy changes that would break autoscaler (validate PassRole/AssumeRole conditions) and add alert if CA repeatedly fails. Also add a routing circuit-breaker on client side to limit retries.

cam (infra): agree. I'll own the rollback postmortem and coordinate with security on deployment gating.

customer-svc: final banner: "Issue mitigated: automated GPU scaling restored and temporary capacity added. If you continue to see latency, please contact support." :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned to priya (sre).

alex (oncall): closing notes: customer impact reduced to informational; no data exposure; root cause: restrictive IAM role condition applied to infra role that blocked autoscaler STS AssumeRole calls. Manual mitigation and routing fallback prevented wider outages. Will open RCA doc.

priya (sre): creating follow-up tasks: - RCA writeup (priya+cam) - infra-cli preflight check (cam) - client-side retry circuit-breaker (leo) - add CA-specific alert on repeated AssumeRole failures (priya)

customer-svc: incident timeline posted to incident tracker.
